title: Regions Cut By Slashes Problem

content.problemStatement:
You're given an n x n grid where each cell holds a code:

- 0 means the cell is empty
- 1 means the cell contains a forward diagonal cut (like a '/' running from its bottom-left corner to its top-right corner)
- 2 means the cell contains a backward diagonal cut (like a '\' running from its top-left corner to its bottom-right corner)

Together the cells form an n x n square, and the diagonal cuts divide that square into regions.

**Return the total number of regions.**
content.inputFormat: Single line: JSON array of all arguments, e.g. [arg1, arg2, ...]

sampleTestCases.explanation: the two diagonal cuts line up to slice the square into 2 regions
a single diagonal cut in one corner cell is not enough to fully separate any region from the rest
the four diagonal cuts meet in the middle like an X, carving out 5 separate regions
